label: The field
subgoals: Read the velocity at a point
Check the direction of the arrow

visual.title: Every arrow is the right-hand side
visual.caption: Each arrow at a point is the vector of derivatives at that point, not a decorative direction. The field converges toward the origin for a stable node.

predict.question: At a stationary point of the vector field, what is the velocity?
predict.explain: A stationary point solves x prime equals zero and y prime equals zero. Both velocity components vanish there.
